name: Unholy Beast
body:
School transmutation [evil]; Level druid 4, lathspell 4, shaman 4, witch 4

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one animal of up to 1 HD/level

Duration 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

You fill the target creature with vile energy, empowering it and putting it under your control. Its form takes on evil aspects of your choice like black eyes, horns, color changes, seeping blood, etc. The target gains a +2 bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution, and a +2 bonus to natural armor. Additionally, its natural weapons are considered one size category larger for damage purposes. Finally, the creature is dominated as per the dominate animal spell. Once the spell ends, the animal reverts to its original form and is shaken by the experience for 1d6 rounds.
